contentText: British police said they evacuated 12,000 people from ​a concert venue in Manchester, northern England, after the release of an "unknown substance" required some in the crowd to be treated and one person to be taken to hospital. Police ​declared ‌a major incident late on Sunday after staff at the ⁠Co-op Live arena alerted them at 10 p.m. (2200 GMT) that people in the crowd had fallen ill during ‌a performance by US rapper Don Toliver.
